The security
denial-audit pool (SL-132, 2 per node) is the third: sangam-security writes `AUTH_DENIED`, `SOD_VIOLATION_BLOCKED` and
`POWER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` to their `sec:d:` denial chains through it (`Options.denialTx`). With the defaults that is 8
connections per node on top of `pool`; a read replica pool counts against the replica's own limit. (2026-11-12:
`SecurityWiring` does not create that pool yet and still passes the main-pool transactions, so until it does the
security denials use main-pool connections and the count is 6.)

The security
denial-audit pool `sangam-security-audit` is the third (SL-132, `sangam.security.denial-audit.pool.maximum-size`, env
`SANGAM_SECURITY_DENIAL_AUDIT_POOL_SIZE`, default 2; `SecurityAuditPoolWiring`): sangam-security writes `AUTH_DENIED`,
`SOD_VIOLATION_BLOCKED` and `POWER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` to their `sec:d:` denial chains through it (`Options.denialTx`), and
the tenant data-key store uses it too (SL-161). With the defaults that is 8 connections per node on top of `pool`; a
read replica pool counts against the replica's own limit.
